announcements.headline: TRADING UPDATE, LOAN NOTE EXTENSION & BOARD CHANGE
announcements.insight: Board changes and loan note extensions follow recent franchise signings. Shareholders should monitor governance stability.

announcements.headline: Time Out Group secures London Market location
announcements.insight: Time Out Group secures a London Market location. This follows recent franchise agreements in Spain, Delhi, Australia, Hong Kong and Singapore.

announcements.headline: Time Out Hong Kong and Singapore Franchise Signed
announcements.insight: Time Out Group expands its franchise network in Asia, following earlier agreements in Australia and Delhi. This continues the pattern of international partnership deals announced in June.

announcements.headline: Time Out Australia Franchise Agreement
announcements.insight: Time Out Group expands its franchise network in Australia, following recent agreements in Spain and Delhi. This signals continued international growth through partnerships.

announcements.headline: Time Out Market Delhi Franchise Agreement Signed
announcements.insight: Time Out Group signs a franchise agreement in Delhi, following recent partnerships in Vancouver and Spain. This expands its global footprint through repeated franchise deals.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. Shareholders should monitor for strategic developments following recent franchise partnerships.

announcements.headline: Time Out Franchise Partnership with RBA in Spain
announcements.insight: Time Out Group expands its franchise model in Spain following the Vancouver market opening. This indicates ongoing international growth and brand extension.

announcements.headline: Time Out Market Vancouver Opens
announcements.insight: Time Out Group has opened a Time Out Market in Vancouver. This represents an operational expansion but lacks financial detail to assess shareholder impact.
